life.damaged.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.not-slate.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.storage-unreadable.text: Your browser couldn't read its storage just now. Reload and try again.
life.storage-unreadable.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.compressed.text: This life was kept compressed, and this browser can't open it. Try a newer one.
life.compressed.where: the slots screen, under a life that can't be read

life.no-storage.text: This browser won't let SLATE keep anything, so no life can be kept here. Check that the site is allowed to store data.
life.no-storage.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

life.device-full.text: There isn't room on this device to keep this life, so nothing changed. Free some space, or let go of a life you don't need, then try again.
life.device-full.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

life.device-refused.text: This device wouldn't keep the life just now, so nothing changed. Try again in a moment.
life.device-refused.where: the slots screen, when keeping a life fails

server.unreachable.text: SLATE couldn't reach the server. Check your connection, then try again.
server.unreachable.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.no-answer.text: The server didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
server.no-answer.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.refused.text: The server turned that down without saying why. Try again in a moment.
server.refused.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.failed.text: The server couldn't finish that. Try again in a moment.
server.failed.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.signed-out.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.bad-request.text: SLATE sent the server something it couldn't use. Reload and try again.
server.bad-request.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.too-big.text: This life has grown too big for the server to keep.
server.too-big.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.damaged.text: The server couldn't read this life, so it didn't keep it.
server.damaged.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.newer.text: This SLATE is newer than the server, so the server won't keep this life rather than risk damaging it.
server.newer.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.behind.text: The server has a later point in this life than this one, so it kept that. Reload to pick it up.
server.behind.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.other-life.text: Another life is already kept there. Let it go before starting a new one in its place.
server.other-life.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

server.no-copy.text: The server has no copy of this life to bring back.
server.no-copy.where: the slots screen, when the server turns something down

weather.model.text: Day to day, the weather here is SLATE's own, drawn around the official averages measured near {place} from {years}.

weather.model-undated.text: Day to day, the weather here is SLATE's own, drawn around the official averages measured near {place}.
weather.model-undated.where: Home, under the weather, where the averages don't say the years they cover

weather.borrowed.text: No averages are published from near here in {country}, so the weather follows those measured near {place}, in {placeCountry}.
weather.borrowed.where: Home, under the weather, where the town's own country publishes none

weather.borrowed-part.text: Not every average is published from near here in {country}, so for those the weather follows the ones measured near {place}, in {placeCountry}.
weather.borrowed-part.where: Home, under the weather, where the town's own country publishes some averages and not others

holidays.unannounced.text: {country} hasn't announced its holidays after {year} yet, so the calendar keeps only those its law fixes.
holidays.unannounced.where: the calendar, on a year past the last a country has announced

holidays.unkept.text: {country}'s public holidays aren't on this calendar, so every day there is kept as an ordinary one.
holidays.unkept.where: the calendar, in a country whose holidays the game doesn't keep

holidays.local.text: Holidays kept only by a town or a district aren't on this calendar; its country's and its region's are.
holidays.local.where: the calendar, under a town's holidays
